name: Shaughnessy Golf and Country Club
location: Vancouver (Southlands, on the North Arm of the Fraser River), British Columbia
architects: A. Vernon Macan (1960, the club's present course; founded 1911 as Shaughnessy Heights Golf Club)

dtm.source: Natural Resources Canada HRDEM (CanElevation) DTM 1 m via the NRCan datacube WCS (datacube.services.geo.ca/ows/elevation, coverage dtm) in EPSG:32610, CGVD2013 m; lidar projects at the course BC-Vancouver_Island_Sunshine_Coast_2018 (2018-19), BC-Lower_Mainland_2016 and VILLE_VANCOUVER 2013; fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-shaughnessy)

dsm.source: Natural Resources Canada HRDEM, the same projects, DSM 1 m (first-return surface), via the same WCS (coverage dsm)
dsm.label: lidar surface model (NRCan HRDEM)

scorecard_source: Third-party (no card on the club's site found): GolfPass (course 26767) per-hole par, men's handicap and Black/Blue/White/White-Green yardages, read 2026-11-13; each row adds up to its total (Black 7,045, par 73). Ratings from the same page's tee table. Unverified against a printed card.
attribution: Elevation and trees: contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada (Natural Resources Canada, HRDEM)
notes: Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1), 2026-11-13: the longest tee set (Black) and it is the default; all water red; OB = the OSM course boundary, roads inside it are cart paths, the driving range is OB; wind 2-10 mph (on the Fraser River near its mouth); trees from the HRDEM surface model (DSM - DTM), trees in fairways or in the way of a centre-line drive removed and listed. Theme shaughnessy (new; the course chat's design).

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (1749 x 1070 m, relation/1425001) + at least 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred (149 m west/east, 233 m south/north)
